primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-complexes-tangent-space (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 5763-5774

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: (RS*) makes the fibres deformation categories; base change identifies the fibre over k with the 2-fibre product, reducing to B = Spec(k) via the tangent-space behaviour of fibre products and the finite dimensionality for schemes; over k, the thickening Spec(k) -> Spec(k[epsilon]) with its canonically equivalent etale topoi and the thickening-relatively-perfect lemma identify the tangent space with lifts of E_0, which the deformation theory lemma computes as Ext^1_{O_{X_0}}(E_0, E_0), and surjects Ext^0 onto Inf; E_0 is pseudo-coherent on the Noetherian X_0 with finite tor dimension and X_0 quasi-compact, so E_0 in D^b_Coh and the Exts are finite dimensional (source lines 5776-5843)
